notes.title: I have lowered the graphics settings by one level overall.
notes.notes: If the game feels too heavy, try lowering the graphics settings further.

notes.title: Window Mode and Power-Up Item Indicators Added
notes.notes:
Window mode has been added to the title screen.
Indicators for power-up items have been added to the base.

notes.title: Difficulty Adjustment of Normal Stages & Displaying Stage Numbers at the Base
notes.notes: We have identified areas that were unclear or too difficult and have made adjustments to lower the difficulty of certain stages. Additionally, the stage numbers are now displayed at the base.

notes.title: Optimization of Heavy Processing Parts
notes.notes: We have identified some areas with heavy processing and performed optimizations accordingly.

notes.title: Graphics Settings and Controller Support
notes.notes:
Graphics Settings: The game now includes three selectable levels of graphics quality: Low, Medium, and High.
Controller Support: Support for PlayStation controllers has been added, allowing players to enjoy the game with their preferred PlayStation gamepads.

notes.title: 5/23　Fix Patch Update
notes.notes: Fixed text errors for game language and English.

notes.title: 5/22/2024　Bug Fix Update
notes.notes: Fixed a problem in which switches in stages 2 and 3 were not responding.
